narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Morning Routine -> Lunch Routine -> Dinner Refusal -> Mental Breakdown -> Relapse
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous narrative to depict the cycle of a strict diet. It shows the initial motivation in the morning and afternoon, followed by the psychological and physical exhaustion at night, which ultimately leads to an enthusiastic 'cheat meal.' It resonates with viewers through relatable dieting struggles.
